CompartmentDataResponse.description: Example response structure. The source defines the fields in the data dictionary, but does not state that every field is required in every response.

BD.description: HKSAR Government Bureau/Department Code. The data dictionary identifies the value as a string and says it is always “COMMON” for the Internal Data Sensor.

C1.description: Measurements for compartment 1, the top compartment.

TS.description: Latest of the data measurement times of all compartments of a smart lamppost. Format YYYYMMDDHHMMSS (ISO 8601 notation, Hong Kong Time).

DI.description: Device ID. The data dictionary identifies the value as a string, with format 2 characters and value “10” for the Internal Data Sensor.

GI.description: Branch/Division/Section code, reserved and currently not in use. The data dictionary identifies the value as a string with default value “00”.

PI.description: Lamppost ID. The data dictionary identifies this as a string with a maximum of 8 characters.

TS.description: Date and time when the JSON packet is created, up to millisecond. The data dictionary specifies a Unix time stamp and default value “0”.

CompartmentMeasurements.description: Temperature and relative-humidity values for a compartment. The source documents string values; “////” indicates failure of quality control, and for compartments 3 and 4 “N.A.” indicates that the compartment does not exist.

RH.description: Relative humidity inside the compartment, in %, with resolution 0.1 %. “////” indicates failure of quality control; for compartments 3 and 4, “N.A.” indicates no such compartment.

T0.description: Temperature inside the compartment, in °C, with resolution 0.1 °C. “////” indicates failure of quality control; for compartments 3 and 4, “N.A.” indicates no such compartment.

MessageResponse.description: Message object shown in documented no-record and error examples.

externalDocs.description: Data Dictionary for Data inside the Compartments of Smart Lampposts

info.description: Retrieves the latest validated compartment sensor data, reported in 10-minute intervals, for a specified Hong Kong smart lamppost. The OpenAPI version field uses “undocumented” as a metadata placeholder; it is not a publisher API version. The source documents API version 2.0 (June 2024; API syntax update effective 25 July 2024).
info.title: Data inside the Compartments of Smart Lampposts

get.description: Returns the latest validated data (in 10-minute intervals) for the specified lamppost. The response is JSON encoded as UTF-8. The API documentation explicitly states that authentication is not required.

parameters.description: Lamppost ID. Maximum 8 characters. For the list of IDs, see the Smart Lampposts Data Inside Compartments Sensors Location Database.

invalid.summary: Request with an ID for which no record is found

parameters.name: pi

noRecord.summary: Example response when no record is found

200.description: Success. The documented example for an unknown ID also returns HTTP 200 with a message indicating that no record was found.

400.description: Bad Request. The example indicates a missing required query parameter.
